articles.title: Dino Bones Aren't Just Rocks — Scientists Found Real Dino Gunk Inside!
articles.summary: Imagine finding a 66-million-year-old scrap of dinosaur skin! Scientists just found real collagen (a bone protein) inside an Edmontosaurus fossil from South Dakota. This could change how we study extinct animals.

articles.title: Mars Had a Mega-Flood! This Giant Valley Is the Proof
articles.summary: A 1,300-kilometer-long valley on Mars, as long as Italy, was carved by a huge ancient flood 3.5 billion years ago. New images from a spacecraft show volcanic ash, collapsed ground, and clues that an ocean might have once covered part of the Red Planet.

articles.title: Crunch Time! Zoos Compete to Find the Cutest Chewer
articles.summary: Zoos are posting videos of tree kangaroos munching veggies in the International Tree Kangaroo Crunch-a-Thon. The contest, with categories for likes and views, aims to raise awareness for these endangered marsupials before World Tree Kangaroo Day on May 21.
